subject: Underdark tunnel
fact: The Underdark tunnel is significantly larger, stretching eighty feet in width and extending hundreds of feet into subterranean darkness.
source_quote: a significantly larger tunnel stretched before them, an impressive passage spanning roughly eighty feet in width and extending for what seemed like hundreds of feet into the subterranean darkness

subject: cavern
fact: The cavern is illuminated by an eerie, pervasive glow emanating from the mystical faerzress and the soft luminescence of bioluminescent fungi clinging to its walls and floor.
source_quote: a breathtaking space illuminated by an eerie, pervasive glow. This light emanated from the mystical faerzress that permeated the Underdark, mixed with the soft luminescence of various bioluminescent fungi clinging to the cavern walls and floor

subject: mesa
fact: The mesa is a substantial rocky plateau dominating the center of the cavern, with crude but functional ramps snaking up its sides to connect its two topmost tiers, linked by a sturdy bridge.
source_quote: Dominating the center of the cavern was a substantial rocky mesa, a raised plateau that formed a distinct feature within the immense space. His attention was soon drawn to the crude but functional ramps that snaked their way up the sides of the mesa, connecting its various levels. These ramps led upwards to the height of the mesa's two topmost tiers, which, remarkably, were linked by a sturdy bridge that spanned the distance between them

subject: egg
fact: The egg is a large, distinctly red object resting atop one of the mesa's highest tiers, visibly vibrant and radiating corruption.
source_quote: His eyes had locked onto a large, distinctly red egg that rested atop one of the mesa's highest tiers. Its size and vibrant color made it a focal point within the dimly lit cavern. And even from afar, he can sense it’s corruption.

subject: obelisk
fact: The obelisk is a fifty-foot-tall structure crafted from smooth, jet-black metal, standing sentinel on the adjacent topmost tier, with noticeable imperfections as if small fragments had been chipped away over time.
source_quote: Standing sentinel on this second tier was a towering structure, a fifty-foot-tall obelisk crafted from a smooth, jet-black metal. Upon closer inspection, he could discern a few noticeable imperfections marring its otherwise flawless surface, appearing as though small fragments had been somehow chipped away over time.

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki is a female derro who gently pats and strokes the surface of the obelisk with a reverent touch, then produces a small notebook to write diligently after the obelisk emits a flash of light.
source_quote: Near the base of this imposing obelisk stood a lone figure: a female derro. Her actions were curious; she stood close to the black metal, gently patting and stroking its cool surface with an almost reverent touch. Suddenly, the obelisk emitted a brief flash of light, a pulse that caused the ambient glow of the faerzress within the cavern to momentarily flare in response, intensifying the eerie illumination. The derro reacted with a sharp squeal of glee at this display. Immediately following the flash, she bent down and snatched an object from the ground near the obelisk. With the object now in hand, she produced a small notebook and began to diligently write something within its pages, her brow furrowed in concentration.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a cleric of Bahamut who points to the egg and declares, 'I am a cleric of Bahamut, and I am drawn to this egg.'
source_quote: Grygum coughs, 'I am a cleric of Bahamut, and I am drawn to this egg.' He points to the egg.

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki shouts, 'Come here!' after becoming excited by Grygum's identity as a cleric of Bahamut, believing her ritual has worked.
source_quote: But something about his demeanor made her excited, 'A cleric of Bahamut to see my creation! Excellent! Then it has worked!' She shouts, 'Come here!'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum circles the mesa, finds a ramp in the back, and starts to climb.
source_quote: Grygum circles the mesa, finds a ramp in the back, and starts to climb.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin follows Grygum from a distance and later asks, 'What would a dragon omelet taste like? And would this one have two yolks?'
source_quote: As he walks, he notices that Thorin, Daz, and Grygum follow him from a distance. ... Thorin shouts, 'What would a dragon omelet taste like? And would this one have two yolks?'

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki motions to several other derro to come to the egg, and Grygum counts them as six.
source_quote: Plinki is ignoring their presence. Instead, she motions to several other Derro to come to the egg. Grygum counts them, 'six.'

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki asks, 'Who are they?' after pointing to Grygum’s friends, and Grygum responds, 'They are my companions. They are not as enlightened as I.'
source_quote: Once standing in front of the egg, Plinki points to Grygum’s friends and asks, 'Who are they?' 'They are my companions. They are not as enlightened as I.' Grygum looks at the egg, and can feel its evil. 'Tell me about this egg?'

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki declares, 'The Grey Ghosts stole it from the Keepers of the Flame. And then I brought it here. I have been using this magical artifact to infuse it with the spirit of a demon in honor of Demogorgon.'
source_quote: The Grey Ghosts stole it from the Keepers of the Flame. And then I brought it here. I have been using this magical artifact to infuse it with the spirit of a demon in honor of Demogorgon.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes that Dragons have freedom of choice, and that goodness and evil flow from the choices of dragons, not their scale color.
source_quote: Unlike traditionalists who view the color of scales as the defining characteristic of Dragons, and that Dragons are fixed in their temperament, Grygum believes that Dragons have freedom of choice. And thus, for Grygum, there is no good or evil dragon because of its scales, but goodness and evil flow from the choices of dragons.

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki declares, 'The beating heart of a cleric of Bahamut will seal the ritual!' and Grygum is not surprised.
source_quote: So when Plinki declares, 'The beating heart of a cleric of Bahamut will seal the ritual!' He’s not surprised.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum shouts, 'The Drow hates dragons and will destroy the egg if you do not back down!'
source_quote: Grygum shouts, 'The Drow hates dragons and will destroy the egg if you do not back down!'

subject: top tier
fact: Zalthir has enveloped the entire top tier in his magical darkness.
source_quote: Zalthir has enveloped the entire top tier in his magical darkness.

subject: Plinki
fact: Plinki shouts, 'Let me go!' and is grappled.
source_quote: Grygum hears the thuds of Zalthir’s fists on the crazed Derro. Plinki shouts, 'Let me go!' Grygum smiles. Plinki has been grappled.

subject: necromantic claw
fact: Grygum utters words of cruel power, rakes his hand through the air before Plinki, and magic forms a great claw that glimmers in the air for the blink of an eye, seeking to rend armor, unstitch flesh, and crush bone.
source_quote: He utters words of cruel power, rakes his hand through the air before Plinki. Magic follows, forming a great claw that glimmers in the air for the blink of an eye. This necromancy seeks to rend armor, unstitch flesh, crush bone—to do whatever it must to destroy your enemy.
